name: options-analysis-suite
description: Access your options analysis data, market research, and portfolio risk metrics directly in Claude.

email.title: Account Email
email.description: Your Options Analysis Suite account email

password.title: Account Password
password.description: Your account password (stored in OS keychain)

tools.name: get_iv_history
tools.description: Get historical implied/historical volatility for a symbol

tools.name: get_greeks_history
tools.description: Get historical options Greeks with recent/trend summaries, plus DTE and moneyness filters for narrower slices

tools.name: get_regime
tools.description: Get regime data at one of six scopes: market (composite stress regime across SPY/QQQ/IWM/DIA), symbol (per-symbol daily regime + authoritative Greek exposures — net gamma/delta/vega/vanna/charm/vomma, call wall, put wall, gamma flip, gamma magnet, top 10 gamma strikes), intraday (5 scans/day with stress scoring + Greek snapshots), volatility (the VIX term structure at the close: VIX1D to VIX6M, its shape, VIX/VIX3M and VVIX), sectors (sector and industry P/E and daily change by exchange, with one group's history), or cot (CFTC Commitments of Traders positioning: a futures contract's family market with every trader group and its 3-year range, or every market's speculative line). Pick via the scope enum; symbol and intraday require `symbol`

tools.name: get_earnings
tools.description: Get earnings history and estimates; with includeMoves, the realized and implied moves around each of the last eight reports (both one-session moves, the implied move from the stored ATM straddle else ATM IV, the IV crush on one tenor, and realized-over-implied ratios)

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Get recent stock-specific news, relevance-ranked by company profile, with full=true for the less-summarized feed

tools.name: get_short_data
tools.description: Get FINRA short-side data for a symbol: type='volume' for daily short-volume activity or type='interest' for biweekly short-interest settlement reports. Compact summary-first views by default; full=true returns the less-summarized payload

tools.name: get_fundamentals
tools.description: Get compact company fundamentals with metadata, key ratios, and summarized statements, plus valuation: the P/E against its sector and industry on its exchange and the market cap with its one- and five-year change

tools.name: get_dividends
tools.description: Get per-symbol dividend history with ex-dates, cash amounts, and payment metadata

tools.name: get_rates
tools.description: Get Treasury rate data: view='benchmark' for the current platform risk-free rate (10Y-based) or view='curve' for the full yield curve with key maturities, inversion flags, and spreads. Use view='curve' for shorter maturities (1M, 3M, 6M, 2Y, 5Y)

tools.name: get_insider_trading
tools.description: Get insider trading with grouped purchase and sale events (open market or private alike), summarized administrative activity and quarterly statistics by transaction date, or scope=market for insider filings across covered companies: purchase and sale totals, the top companies by value and the individual lines

tools.name: get_institutional_ownership
tools.description: Get a company's or an ETF's institutional ownership from quarterly Form 13F filings: institutions, shares, reported value and share of market cap, changes from the quarter before, calls and puts, the top holders and the quarterly history, and the ETFs holding it

tools.name: get_congress_trades
tools.description: Get trades by members of Congress and their households from their STOCK Act reports: a company's trades with totals, or scope=market for the trades first disclosed over recent days with the companies traded most; party on the trade date, amount ranges, trade and disclosure dates

tools.name: get_options_analytics_history
tools.description: Get historical daily analytics snapshots (IV, skew, expected move, risk-free rate, GEX/DEX/VEX, net vanna/charm/vomma); for walls and current Greek exposures use get_regime with scope='symbol'

tools.name: get_iv_surface
tools.description: Get IV surface/skew across strikes and expirations

tools.name: get_stock_prices
tools.description: Get historical OHLCV bars (daily, weekly or monthly) with a compact trend summary, a labelled volume-weighted average, and optional Stock Charts indicators (up to six, by catalogue name and the chart's own parameters) computed on the returned bars

tools.name: get_stock_splits
tools.description: Get per-symbol stock split history with ratios and labels

tools.name: get_analyst_data
tools.description: Get analysts' monthly rating counts and their 12-month history, individual price targets, price-target summaries, nearest forward estimate periods, recent rating changes, and a quantitative model grade

tools.name: get_market_calendar
tools.description: Get market calendar events by type: type='economic' (macro events: FOMC, CPI, NFP, etc.), 'ipo' (upcoming/recent listings), 'dividend' (ex/record/payment dates), or 'split' (stock splits). Each type has its own default date window and per-type filters (country for economic; symbol for ipo/dividend/split)

tools.name: get_options_chain
tools.description: Get the latest available end-of-day options chain summary by default, with expirations, ATM term structure, skew, and representative near-money contracts across the curve; a specific date can also be requested

tools.name: get_sec_filings
tools.description: Get recent SEC EDGAR filings with form/category summaries and merger and offering flags (the newest merger, tender offer or going-private filing within 120 days and the newest shelf registration or securities offering within 30, with counterparties) by default, full=true for the less-summarized filing list, and scope=market for recent merger, tender offer and going-private filings across covered companies

tools.name: get_fail_to_deliver
tools.description: Get SEC Failure-to-Deliver data with a compact recent/spike summary by default and full=true for less-summarized sanitized history; default window is 180 days because SEC publication lags about 21 days

tools.name: get_threshold_history
tools.description: Get SEC Reg SHO threshold-list history with a compact current/recent status summary by default and full=true for the less-summarized date list

tools.name: get_dark_pool_data
tools.description: Get FINRA OTC (non-ATS) and ATS (dark pool) weekly trading data. view='summary' (default) returns aggregate weekly volume/trade trends + compact summary; view='dealers' breaks OTC flow down to the top 15 dealer MPIDs per week; view='venues' breaks ATS flow down to the top 15 dark-pool venue MPIDs per week; view='all' returns summary+dealers+venues in one payload

tools.name: get_trading_halts
tools.description: Get active and recent trading halts with duplicate feed rows condensed and latest active halt states prioritized by default

tools.name: get_activist_filings
tools.description: Get Schedule 13D/13G beneficial-ownership filings with current above-threshold holder snapshots by default and below-threshold amendments summarized separately; full=true returns the less-summarized filing list

tools.name: get_live_options_chain
tools.description: Get a LIVE options chain for one expiration from the broker connected to your account (Pro and above); the only tool with intraday option prices

tools.name: get_live_dealer_positioning
tools.description: Get LIVE dealer positioning from your connected broker's chain (Pro and above): net GEX/DEX, vega, vanna, charm and vomma, the gamma flip, call and put walls, and the gamma regime over the nearest four expirations

tools.name: scan_option_strategies
tools.description: Scan one expiration of your connected broker's live chain for option strategy candidates (Pro and above): single options, vertical spreads, iron condors and butterflies, straddles and strangles, priced from two-sided quotes with payoff, risk-neutral model probabilities, position Greeks and distances to the expected move and dealer levels

tools.name: get_live_quote
tools.description: Get a LIVE quote for one underlying (stock, ETF or index) from the broker connected to your account (Pro and above): last, bid, ask, sizes, mid, mark, the session's open, high and low, previous close, volume, the broker's quote and trade times, and change against the previous close

tools.name: get_intraday_bars
tools.description: Get one session's LIVE intraday bars (1 to 30 minutes) for a stock, ETF or index from the broker connected to your account (Pro and above; Tradier and Schwab), with the session VWAP and its band, a session summary, and Stock Charts indicators computed on the same bars

tools.name: rank_live_skew_gex
tools.description: Rank a watchlist of up to 50 symbols LIVE by 25-delta skew and net GEX, each with its change since the prior session's close, computed by one model on the live chains from the broker connected to your account and on the prior session's stored chains (Pro and above); may spend the whole per-broker request budget, and a long list is finished over several calls with the same list

tools.name: get_options_snapshot
tools.description: Get the end-of-day options snapshot for a symbol (spot, max pain, net GEX/DEX, ATM IV term structure, IV rank and percentile, historical vol, volume and open interest), with optional per-strike curve summaries; pass several symbols to compare headline metrics in one request

tools.name: get_regime_fits
tools.description: Get the calibrated parameters and fit quality for the eight pricing models on a symbol, with an error history (Pro and above; regime universe of about 124 symbols)

tools.name: get_dealer_positioning
tools.description: Get end-of-day dealer positioning from the most recent session on file over 0-60 days: net GEX/DEX, dealer regime, gamma flip, call and put walls, gamma magnet, 30-day expected move and top contributing strikes, for roughly 5,500 listed equities and ETFs

tools.name: compute_black_scholes
tools.description: Price a European option with Black-Scholes from explicit inputs (Pro and above): price, seventeen Greeks in the commercial API's convention, expected move and risk-neutral ITM probability; r and q supplied or resolved from stored market data, never defaulted

tools.name: compute_scenario
tools.description: Reprice a multi-leg options strategy across spot moves, vol-point shocks and days elapsed (Pro and above): a P&L grid against each leg's entry, base Greeks in the commercial API's convention, inputs supplied or resolved from stored end-of-day data with their source named, and an optional portfolio fit against held positions (Greeks by underlying, expiration and sector; correlation over sixty daily log returns; a uniform stress across every underlying)

tools.name: get_platform_info
tools.description: Get platform background information

tools.name: get_custom_indicator_spec
tools.description: Get the format reference for custom indicator scripts on the Stock Charts page (the text the page's Copy-AI-prompt button gives a model): an index of sections by default, one section by id, to write or convert an indicator the user pastes into the page

tools.name: get_analysis_history
tools.description: Get user's options pricing analysis history, with near-identical reruns collapsed in the default view and full=true for less-summarized sanitized history

tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: Get user synced snapshots by type: 'gex' (per-symbol Gamma Exposure — requires symbol; returns 3 most recent snapshots, no dedupe; includes raw vs in-wall visible combo counts when available), 'portfolio' (account-wide portfolio snapshots with market-scaled raw Greeks; default view collapses consecutive identical snapshots), or 'risk' (account-wide risk analysis with $-impact Greeks, VaR, stress tests; default view collapses consecutive identical snapshots), or 'strategy' (the strategy definitions sent from the Strategy page's AI Assistant panel: symbol, legs, premiums and vols, the page's inputs; definitions only, priced on demand by compute_scenario via strategyKey)

tools.name: get_analysis_rollups
tools.description: Get user's analysis trend aggregates with compact rollup rows, cross-period summaries, and full=true for less-summarized sanitized synced rows

tools.name: get_fft_results
tools.description: Get user's FFT scanner results — mispricing signals and calibration data

tools.name: query_analysis
tools.description: Query analysis history with numeric filters (delta, volatility, DTE ranges), with near-identical reruns collapsed in the default view

tools.name: get_compute_runs
tools.description: Get user's AI Compute Suite run history with compact run summaries, exposure levels, and representative position/model consensus summaries; use view='detailed' for one matched run's per-model outputs, or full=true for less-summarized sanitized synced runs

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Get a compact normalized company profile with float metrics, identifiers, a trimmed description and ESG scores and risk rating, and for a fund its facts, holdings and weights; use full=true for the less-summarized synced row

tools.name: run_screener
tools.description: Run one of 16 options-market screeners (most-active, highest-oi, highest-iv, unusual, gex, model-divergence, regime-stress, term-backwardation, put-skew, delta-exposure, vega-exposure, pre-earnings-iv, dod-change, vrp, max-pain, unusual-directional) plus market-trends (time-series aggregates) and earnings-calendar (next-14-days upcoming earnings, widen with days up to 90). Pick via the screener enum; sub-params (view, index, metric, side, mode, direction, threshold, days, symbol) apply only to the screener that needs them. earnings-calendar returns a bare array of rows; every other screener returns a wrapped payload
